purpose: Machine-readable inventory of governed files, roles, descriptions, read priority and source-of-truth relationships.

files.description: Human-readable overview of thesis, architecture, scope, MVP, NVIDIA track and current repository state.
Operating rules for Codex and other agents: read order, evidence discipline, architecture changes, security, testing and stop conditions.
Repository-native vector rendering of the current Human Intelligence Platform conceptual architecture.
Semantic source of truth for architecture layers, nodes, relationships, governance flow and feedback loop.

Defines canonical project categories, prefixes, claim classes, maturity states, statuses, sensitivity classes and naming conventions.
Tracks important project variables, values, validation status and their source-of-truth artifact.
Inventory and description of governed repository files with read priority and source-of-truth roles.

inventory_rules: Inventory only files that exist or are created in the same governed change.
Do not list empty planned directories as implemented artifacts.
Every new governed artifact should be added to the next inventory version.
Use descriptions to explain purpose, not merely repeat file names.
